summary: Can-Fite BioPharma filed a Form 6-K on July 6, 2026, announcing completion of patient enrollment in its pivotal Phase 3 psoriasis study for Piclidenoson, a clinical-stage biotechnology milestone. The filing is a routine operational update regarding a drug development program, not a special situation. The press release details enrollment of 247 patients for an interim analysis under FDA and EMA-agreed protocol, with data expected Q4 2026/Q1 2027. No acquisition, divestiture, activist, tender, or other special-situation event occurred. This is a standard progress report on clinical trial enrollment, not a corporate transaction or strategic change.
